sn12.52:1.2: upādānīyesu bhikkhave dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati.
sn12.52:2.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, dasannaṃ vā kaṭṭhavāhānaṃ vīsāya vā kaṭṭhavāhānaṃ tiṃsāya vā kaṭṭhavāhānaṃ cattārīsāya vā kaṭṭhavāhānaṃ mahāaggikkhandho jaleyya,
sn12.52:2.2: tatra puriso kālena kālaṃ sukkhāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya, sukkhāni ca gomayāni pakkhipeyya, sukkhāni ca kaṭṭhāni pakkhipeyya,
sn12.52:2.3: evaṃ hi so bhikkhave mahāaggikkhandho tadāhāro tadupādāno ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ jaleyya.
sn12.52:2.4: evameva kho bhikkhave, upādānīyesu dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati.
sn12.52:3.1: upādānīyesu bhikkhave, dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati.
sn12.52:4.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, dasannaṃ vā kaṭṭhavāhānaṃ vīsāya vā kaṭṭhavāhānaṃ tiṃsāya vā kaṭṭhavāhānaṃ cattārīsāya vā kaṭṭhavāhānaṃ mahāaggikkhandho jaleyya,
sn12.52:4.2: tatra puriso na kālena kālaṃ sukkhāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya. na sukkhāni ca gomayāni pakkhipeyya, na sukkhāni ca kaṭṭhāni pakkhipeyya,
sn12.52:4.3: evaṃ hi so bhikkhave mahāaggikkhandho purimassa ca upādānassa pariyādānā aññassa ca anupahārā anāhāro nibbāyeyya.
sn12.52:4.4: evameva kho bhikkhave, upādānīyesu dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati.
